author: Pallavi Chaudry
text:
Hi

If you don’t get hypo symptoms then you aren’t safe to drive with or without sensors. (The sensors are just an indicator and are not 100% reliable). 

When you go low using a sensor, you should still be finger pricking to accurately assess your next steps. 

The problem is, you may be high one minute and driving, and then go low all of a sudden and not have the ability to park in a safe place to self monitor. You would therefore be a danger to other road users too.

I hope this makes sense. 

🙂
